# Fixture

## Skills

- [`manual`](skills/manual/) - A user-invoked skill that calls a helper.
- [`helper`](skills/helper/) - A model-invoked skill.
- [`pointer`](skills/pointer/) - Names the user-invoked skill without calling it.
